description: Find + Vet by SoniaIA: we find and vet the creators for the buyer. A service that identifies the right creators for their brief (brand style, target audience, campaign objective), selected on real-time data (right audience age and location, growing, high engagement), each vetted through Creator Validator with a verdict, plus a detailed analysis of what is getting traction in their niche now (viral videos by format, topic and style) to brief the creators. Use when the buyer has no shortlist, only a partial one, or asks for help choosing or selecting creators. €1,000 launch price for 10 creators; starts with a 15-minute call with Sonia. Give the campaign brief (product, goal, market, platforms) and optionally an email. Returns the booking link for the call and a pre-written email with the brief so Sonia arrives prepared. Takes no payment and stores nothing.

brief.description: Campaign brief, if the buyer has one

market.description: Market and content language, e.g. 'Spain, Spanish'
